resources.string: The weather where you look most: on your home screen. Beautiful widgets, honest forecasts, nothing to configure.
Where should the forecast come from?
You can change this any time in settings.
Free, nothing to set up. Ready now.
Google\'s forecasts. Needs your own free API key; we\'ll walk you through it.
Use your location for local weather, or pick a city.
Approximate location is enough. It stays on your phone and is only sent, rounded, to the weather source.
Put it on your home screen
Widgets are the best part of Ameki. Add one now; there are four more in your launcher\'s widget list.
Long-press your home screen, tap Widgets and look for Ameki.
